request: Keep extracted details, source quotations and proposed work internal; show only a greeting or brief acknowledgement for this stage.
observable_pass_condition: New browser replies and reopened replies show the same code-owned greeting or receipt. Source-linked preparation and review remain saved privately, and future context contains the exact acknowledgement actually displayed.
consequential_counterexamples: A draft claiming completed work or a planned activity must not become public text.
Changing only the HTTP response would leave different NM words in saved history; publication is therefore owned by the canonical release renderer.
An all-rejected preparation without a greeting still yields a truthful withheld service result, not a false successful answer.
Unknown versions or changed saved response fields cannot be replayed; original source ownership is checked by the turn boundary even when the acknowledgement has no quotations.

logic.public: Fixed greeting when selected; otherwise Message received. when at least one unit has passed existing review.
logic.internal: Source text, material proposals, actions, drafts, proof, omissions and partial review state remain private.
logic.meaning: The acknowledgement confirms receipt only. It does not certify complete extraction, fact admission, research, execution or requested-task completion.
logic.history: Existing v1 source-quotation replies reconstruct under their unchanged original renderer. They are not rewritten.

prompt_change: The single independent-review prompt now states that preparation is private and only a greeting or receipt is displayed. Its per-unit source, attribution, scope and omission review remains in place.

operations.label_message: Full original latest input and prior conversation to one proposed message label.
operations.prepare_response: Complete original input to private material, action plans and a draft.
operations.review_prepared_response: Original conversation plus proposals to per-unit support decisions, omissions and greeting selection.

verification.browser_method: Real Chrome page clicks and typing through Playwright CDP using the existing synthetic account.

remaining_work: The existing broad response-preparation extractor is unchanged. This checkpoint does not establish its semantic accuracy.

The live greeting was still extracted as a material proposal and accepted by review. Keeping it private fixes display only; identifying meaningful disputes and objectives remains a separate extraction task.

Next extraction piece: identify only disputes and desired matter outcomes from coherent portions of mixed input, in full context. Either list may be empty; do not invent an objective for a dispute or confuse a requested NM task with a desired matter outcome. Preserve supporting original words and uncertainty. No new extraction contract or model call has been implemented in this piece.
Natural summaries, action execution, research and historical matter processing remain outside the currently connected flow.
Original v1 messages remain visible as previously delivered when their historical chats reopen.
